scope: All currently assigned skills, first unlock only. Skill values, learning caps, SP costs and existing DB unlocks unchanged. New proposal supersedes early pet unlock plan. Selected intermediate unlocks between levels 21 and 39; class-defining combinations start at level 40 and expand through level 43. All existing character classes retained; no invented advancement quest.
notes: Skill rank upgrade character-level requirements remain undefined. Unlocking does not auto-learn a skill; prerequisite ranks require SP as usual.
Advanced packages unlock across levels 40-43; prerequisite skills must be learned first. No minimum rank above 1 invented.
Morrak, Nature Spirit and Soul Companion each unlock at level 40 through their quest. Quest names and identifiers are not defined; only Morrak explicitly requires defeating the demon.
Holzspalter proposed at level 1 instead of tentative level 2 to give Gladiator a simple initial attack.
Volles Potential proposed at level 40 instead of tentative level 30, matching new specialization boundary.
Body Reinforcement proposed at level 21; early attacks and weapon training remain available before it.
Knight Heal removed by user instruction. Replacement slot intentionally empty.
